svg.text: McLaren F1 — line scaffold and fairing
138 body curves · 620 cells · radius delivered within 99% median over 135 stations
81 unmarked — the field blends across, no line
24 panel gaps — a shutline, not a fold
23 knife edges — the only line this tool had before A12
10 faired — R6, R14→70, band drawn to scale
